Acquisition.com Business Model: How Alex Hormozi Makes Money & Scales Equity

The financial architecture behind Acquisition.com represents a structural inversion of the traditional private equity playbook. While standard venture capital firms rely on heavy marketing budgets to acquire founders, and traditional private equity firms utilize massive debt leverage to buy assets, Alex Hormozi’s business model prioritizes asset-light scaling through minority-equity investments.

How Alex Hormozi Built Gym Launch and Sold His Business for $250M Empire

The trajectory of Alex Hormozi’s career offers a masterclass in operational leverage and business model evolution. Starting with his own gym locations, he transitioned into a licensable platform that eventually reported over $250 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). This article dissects how Gym Launch was built, the specific growth levers employed, and the strategic reasoning behind the Gym Launch exit strategy.

Who Is Alex Hormozi? A Profile of Modern Entrepreneurship

Alex Hormozi is a first-generation Iranian-American entrepreneur, investor, and author who has become one of the most recognizable figures in the business world. Known for his direct communication style and focus on value creation, he co-founded Acquisition.com with his wife, Leila. His journey from operating brick-and-mortar gyms to building a software company generating over $250 million in aggregate annual revenue defines a modern case study in scaling.
